title: Signature Skill Cartographer
description: Signature original — the signature cartographer of skills: every capability mapped, every dependency drawn. The map is the territory of competence. Learning gets navigated.

demo.code:
print("mapped: 1,204 skills (signature survey)")
print("navigate: confidently")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'Signature cartographer', 'nodes': 'All skills', 'edges': 'All deps', 'use': 'Navigation', 'benefit': 'Navigated', 'complexity': 'Medium'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'nodes', 'edges', 'use', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")
